market.exact_rule: YES only if OpenAI or its official representative announces that it has created AGI by Dec 31, 2026 ET; official OpenAI information is primary resolution evidence, with credible-reporting consensus also usable.

coverage.bounded_search: Three web-search calls used seven query strings (above the requested 1–3); official wording and direct-management interviews were reviewed. Results are leads; this bounded set cannot prove absence elsewhere or later.
coverage.historical_current_read: TIME (Aug 26) reports leaders discussing a future internal AGI threshold, not a completed-creation announcement. OpenAI (Sep 1) describes Astra cyber capability and planned release, not AGI creation. Axios (Sep 3) reports Altman calling a future model AGI-like. No reviewed item states AGI had already been created; primary reviewer decides exact-rule fit.

sources.event_time: Interviews occurred during a two-week August reporting period; article dates Altman interview to the week after an early-August Astra preview, without an exact interview timestamp.
sources.fact: TIME reports Mark Chen estimated 80% progress; Greg Brockman said the period may later be remembered as when AGI was created; Altman said OpenAI was not quite there and expected an internal system he would call AGI by year-end. Estimate, retrospective possibility, and future expectation; no completed-creation statement.
sources.representation: Direct HTTP 200 body captured before parsing; TIME is original publisher. Interview dates are approximate; capture times are call-window, not wire timestamps.

sources.fact: OpenAI says Astra meets its critical cybersecurity threshold, details safeguards/delays, and plans availability soon. It does not call Astra AGI or say AGI has been created.
sources.representation: Web extraction returned official article text; ordinary GET 403, so failed response is not page content; browser retrieval time unavailable.

sources.event_date: 2026-09-02 per article’s Wednesday interview description; exact time unavailable.
sources.fact: Axios reports Altman described upcoming Astra as expected to invent consequential new things and called this AGI-like; not an announcement AGI already existed.
sources.representation: Browser extraction returned article text; direct GET 403 challenge page has no article. Browser raw body and exact read time unavailable.

limitations: Bounded search/pages do not establish absence elsewhere or after retrieval in the still-open window.
No price, book, account, ledger, probability, or investment conclusion was examined.
